name: search_tools
description: Free. Search the 1,012 ScorpTech x402 tools by keyword and optional group. Returns tool names, prices, descriptions and input schemas.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Keywords, e.g. dns, sec filings, solana wallet

arguments.name: group
arguments.desc: crypto, sec, security, web, dev or other

name: call_tool
description: Run any ScorpTech tool by name. Costs that tool's price in USDC via x402 (Solana or Base); unpaid calls return the x402 PaymentRequired object. Charged only on success.
